space.expression: Space of the reduced-dimension solver C.

notes: Exploits the event that a discarded coordinate subset misses the sparse support. C denotes a specified residual LWE solver, so this is a reduction/tradeoff rather than a standalone universal LWE exponent.

extra.parameters: Fix h≥0 and d>1 independent of n; p_{h,d}=lim_{n→∞}binom(n−h,n/d)/binom(n,n/d)=(1−1/d)^h.
extra.noise: Original error distribution/width αq is retained by the zero-support branch.
extra.secret: Uniform support of Hamming weight h with small ternary nonzero values; basic support argument does not depend on their magnitudes.
extra.samples: Same original sample budget passed to residual instances; residual solver requirements remain explicit.
extra.objective: Solve LWE using independent support-avoidance trials and a residual solver C.
extra.model: C(N,α,q) is cost at the fixed required high success probability; d=2 gives p=2^{−h}.
extra.assumptions: Uniform/random sparse support; high-success residual solver; fixed h,d.
extra.success: Constant support-avoidance probability per trial, amplified by O(1/p_{h,d}) trials.

evidence.locator: Section Sparse secrets, Asymptotic behaviour lemma and following d=2 remark
